title: Lost Mary Nera15K Juicy Peach Prefilled Vape Pod
description: The Juicy Peach Lost Mary Nera15K Prefilled Pod delivers a smooth, mellow fruit flavour that’s sweet yet delicate. Each puff brings the soft, juicy taste of ripe Peach, creating a simple but satisfying vape that’s light enough to enjoy from morning to night. Every pack contains one 2ml Prefilled Pod prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, alongside a 15ml Refill Pod that automatically tops up the pod as you vape. Together they provide up to 15,000 puffs depending on usage, with no need for refills or coil changes. Fitted with a 0.6ohm mesh coil, the pod produces smooth vapour and consistent flavour clarity. Designed for the Lost Mary Nera30K Prefilled Pod Kit, installation is quick and mess-free: simply click the pod and refill pod into place and you’re ready to go. How to Use: 1. Remove all packaging and protective film. 2. Separate the 2ml prefilled pod and 10ml refill container. 3. Push the refill container into the pod until it clicks securely. 4. Attach the pod to your Nera30K device and remove the silicone plug from the mouthpiece. 5. Vape and enjoy. Once the e-liquid runs out, simply swap in a new Nera15K pod pack from a selection of 20 incredible Lost Mary flavour profiles.
